credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Handheld double beater mixer. Top has semi-circular handle, middle has rotting circle attached to a handle to make the beaters move. Base is two beaters attached to a u-shaped metal brace. Exterior of beaters read "STAINLESS U.S.A." on each strip of metal. Each beater has four of these strips that form the exterior structure for a hollow interior.
title: Mixer
